intro: Eight articles on Fortinet span 14 April 2026 to 10 September 2026, covering a severity mix of six critical and two high issues. The Gentlemen appear among the tracked threat actors. Prominent vulnerabilities include CVE-2026-20079 at CVSS 10, CVE-2025-59718 at CVSS 9.8, CVE-2026-21643 at CVSS 9.1, alongside CVE-2024-55591 and CVE-2025-32433. Affected sectors include government, the federal civilian executive branch, financial services, software consultancy, and technology. Impacted regions span Europe, North America, Turkey, the UK, and the United States.
